entries.summary: CONDITIONAL_MARKER_RE eats surrounding whitespace without requiring an own-line marker, and the resolver has no fence awareness.

entries.title: vcs_credential_exec has two token placeholders with opposite quoting contracts, and mixing them up surfaces as a false 401
entries.summary: The bare vcs_token placeholder is substituted already quoted; the vcs_token_inline placeholder gets interior-only escaping for use inside caller quotes. Picking the wrong one double-escapes or leaves the token unquoted.

entries.title: A fallback message sharing the assertion's alternate keyword makes a test vacuous
entries.summary: checkDoltRemoteAbsent's bd-unavailable fallback messages all contain the word "unavailable", so the old combined assertion /Dolt-level remotes|unavailable/ was satisfied on any machine without bd without ever reaching the parser under test. Merged main closes this by probing bd --version first and asserting the two cases separately. The reusable trap: never OR an assertion's success keyword with its own fallback keyword.

entries.title: kb_bible_commit and kb_export share one bible admission predicate
entries.summary: kb_bible_commit now admits a CONFIRMED id only if filterProjectBibleCandidates (bible-basis-filter.ts) passes it, the same rule kb_export scope=project uses; failures are skipped with reason basis_mismatch.

entries.title: In Git Bash, a background job's $! is an MSYS pid that never equals the process's own process.pid
entries.summary: Under MSYS/MinGW bash on Windows, $! returns the MSYS-internal pid while a spawned native Node process reports a different native Windows pid via process.pid, so any script that proves identity by comparing $! against a pid the process reports about itself can never match.

entries.title: runSprintCycle now hosts zero inline phase bodies, and that is mechanically pinned rather than described
entries.summary: After the final slice, runner.js builds no phase() label at all; phase-sequence-order.test.mjs asserts a zero-match shape scan over runner.js with a >=12 count across phases/* as its non-vacuity control.

entries.title: Usage-limit pause budget resets per re-dispatch, not per role
entries.summary: The usage-limit controller's MAX_WAIT_S/MAX_REPROBES budget applies per onUsageLimit invocation, so a role's total pause time across repeated clear-then-refail cycles is not capped.

entries.title: The sync-bracket guarantee is mechanically scanned by a fifth guard, not just a convention
entries.summary: A fifth guard (unbracketed-push-guard.mjs) scans every guarded module for bare sync primitives outside git-sync.mjs, superseding the earlier claim that nothing enforced the bracket rule.

entries.title: normalizeMsysPathForPlatform is the required seam before path.resolve on any env-sourced path
entries.summary: Node's path.resolve does not understand MSYS /c/... paths and on win32 prefixes them with the current drive, so any filesystem path arriving from a Git Bash environment variable must go through normalizeMsysPathForPlatform first.

entries.title: scaledTimeout treats an empty APRA_FLEET_TEST_CONCURRENCY exactly like unset: unscaled base budget
entries.summary: scaled-timeout.mjs parses the env var with Number() and returns the unscaled base whenever the result is not finite or <= 1; Number('') is 0, so an empty-string export silently disables contention scaling with no warning.

entries.title: The slow-lane stalled-session bounds bind to DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_S, not the inactivity budget
entries.summary: Both the lower and upper wall-clock bounds in the stalled-session slow test resolve through the watchdog pin, which is the row's maxTotalS, so the test cannot discriminate the inactivity budget from the total budget.

entries.title: Parent-NOTES staleness collector misses closed children because its bd list --parent call omits closed issues
entries.summary: collectParentNotesStalenessNotes in parent-notes-staleness.mjs lists a bead's children with plain `bd list --parent <id> --json`, which excludes closed issues by default, so the 'most recently created child' calculation is blind to closed children -- causing false negatives and false positives.

entries.title: StdioTransport.stop() is synchronous -- awaiting it with .catch() throws a TypeError
entries.summary: apra-fleet-client's StdioTransport.stop() returns undefined, so the common teardown idiom `await stop().catch(() => {})` throws TypeError inside a finally block and skips the cleanup after it.

entries.title: A migrated role's ladderAnchor deliberately matches ZERO agent() sites, so the inline-ladder guard's zero must be falsified per role
entries.summary: Once a role is marked migrated the anchor assertion inverts: matching no call site is the expected state, which means checkModules()'s zero says nothing on its own and has to be proven falsifiable by seeding a ladder for every role migratedRoleNames() returns.

entries.title: scripts/run-integ-suites.mjs always runs the whole apra-fleet-se test directory; no per-file scoping
entries.summary: The real-bd integ harness computes pending files from readdirSync(test).sort() with no caller-supplied subset, so reaching one late-alphabet file can take a long time behind the mock-sprint-* long poles.

entries.title: The dolt-orphan-sweep owner filter lives only in the generated shell string, never in JS
entries.summary: buildSweepCommand embeds the port range, age and --data-dir owner filter into a PowerShell or ps|awk string; sweepOnce reports every ORPHAN line as killed with no JS-side re-check, so only tests that inspect or execute the generated command can catch a dropped owner argument.

entries.title: schema-validated-fake-api.mjs only guards MCP tool INPUT drift; a tool's OUTPUT field rename is invisible to it
entries.summary: The workflow package's fake API validates outgoing payloads against real zod input schemas, but its canned responses are hand-typed; output shapes need a source-anchored pin like schema-validated-fake-api-output-shape.test.mjs.

entries.title: DEGRADE_STEPS is separate from POST_RESULT_STEPS because the reviewer's round session must be dropped on failure and kept on success
entries.summary: role-policies.mjs has three step vocabularies, and the split is load-bearing rather than tidy: a step in the wrong list gets the per-round reviewer's session handling exactly backwards.

entries.title: git says (fetch first), not (non-fast-forward), when the diverging remote tip was never fetched
entries.summary: A rejected push reports (non-fast-forward) only once the remote tip has been fetched; before that it says (fetch first), so the diverged verdict for that commoner case rests on the [rejected], failed to push some refs and updates were rejected rules, not /non-fast-forward/.

entries.title: A nested node --test child silently no-ops unless NODE_TEST_CONTEXT is stripped from its env
entries.summary: node --test sets NODE_TEST_CONTEXT on its own process; a child spawned with it still present returns empty stdout and exit 0 without running anything, so any nested-suite gate must delete it and then assert a non-zero '# pass' count.

entries.title: A runner.js back-import is safe for hoisted function declarations but TDZ-unsafe for const values read at module-load time
entries.summary: member-sync.mjs and beads-children.mjs can back-import resolveSettleShell from runner.js because it is a hoisted function declaration called only at runtime, but kb.mjs cannot back-import runner.js ROLE_DOER because KB_SELF_INJECTING_ROLES builds a frozen Set from it at module-evaluation time.

entries.title: bdListScoped gives fresh STATUS but never fresh SCOPE -- scope always comes from the cached snapshot
entries.summary: A filtered bdListScoped() call issues a real bd list, but intersects it with scopeIds derived from the possibly-stale allBeadsSnapshot, so a bead CREATED behind the command() seam stays invisible until the snapshot drops even on a 'fresh' read.

entries.title: The runner signal-path tests only run on POSIX, so Windows-only verification proves little
entries.summary: tests/run-all-tests-timeout.test.ts skips its nested-grandchild-reap and outer-SIGTERM suites on Windows; run npm test on Linux/macOS before trusting changes to runner signal/kill paths.

entries.title: toolErrorText survives a contentless isError envelope, so the kb_ rejected-logging paths cannot throw
entries.summary: A degenerate MCP result of exactly {isError:true} with no content array still produces a usable log line ('no error text returned') instead of throwing inside the non-fatal handler.

entries.title: The pushCode:true dispatch set is four sites (doer + harvester, each with its resume), not two
entries.summary: Exactly four dispatch policies carry pushCode:true (doer and its resume, harvester and its resume); every other role dispatch is read-side. The flag lives in role-policies.mjs (doer :835, harvester :1262, read by dispatch-role.mjs into withGitSync) and is pinned by dispatch-sync-bracket-coverage.test.mjs.

entries.title: Phase 5 consumer migration end state is fully landed and pinned
entries.summary: readMemberVcsCredentialToken and parseExpiresAtFromProvisionText are completely deleted from fleet-sprint/ (not merely deprecated); buildCredentialReadCommand is deliberately kept dead-in-production/live-in-tests with no deprecation marker; member-provisioning.mjs and coordination.mjs have zero prose-branching (includes/match/toLowerCase) control flow.

entries.title: .fleet/ mixes a tracked deliverable (kb-canonical.json) with per-round scratch (planner-output.json)
entries.summary: Before adding a .gitignore rule under .fleet/, check git ls-files first -- .fleet/kb-canonical.json is a tracked, checked-in KB export deliverable, so a blanket '.fleet/' ignore rule would silently shadow it exactly the way this repo's own sprint-logs/ note warns against for directory-level ignore rules.

entries.title: Naming a test file mock-sprint-* enrolls it in phase3's nested run and real-bd budget
entries.summary: phase3-dispatch-engine-completeness.test.mjs discovers test/mock-sprint-*.test.mjs by prefix at runtime, so the filename alone decides whether a file is re-run in a nested child and counted into the real-bd nested-suite budget.

entries.title: Sandbox module imports in fleet-sprint tests must use pathToFileURL().href, not a raw absolute path
entries.summary: A raw absolute path handed to dynamic import() fails on Windows (parsed as scheme 'c:') and also fails on POSIX whenever the tmpdir path contains a space or '#'.

entries.title: KB knowledge reaches a dispatch by one of three paths, and a resume dispatch of a self-injecting role gets none
entries.summary: The agent() wrapper injects the knowledge block only for an agentType outside KB_SELF_INJECTING_ROLES; doer/reviewer get it from their prompt builders; a dispatch with no agentType, and every resume prompt of a self-injecting role, receives no block at all.

entries.title: Golden-transcript mocks ignore bd close failures, which resurface as a misleading stall-abort
entries.summary: The doer and integ-test-runner handlers in both golden-transcript test files run `bd close` via runCmd and discard its err, so a failed close is invisible and reappears cycles later as a stall-abort blaming the verifier.

entries.title: copyDirResolved only utf-8 rewrites allowlisted text extensions
entries.summary: apra-pm install.mjs copyDirResolved round-trips files through a utf-8 string only for RESOLVABLE_TEXT_EXTENSIONS (.md/.json/.txt); everything else is copyFileSync, because the string round-trip corrupts binary bytes.

entries.title: The repo's commit hook ASCII check silently no-ops on macOS because it uses grep -P
entries.summary: A git commit of N changed files prints N 'grep: invalid option -- P' lines on macOS BSD grep; the commit succeeds and the hook's non-ASCII check never actually runs.

entries.title: strategy.execCommand resolves on non-zero exit; it rejects only on timeout, spawn/connection error or abort
entries.summary: Both LocalStrategy and RemoteStrategy resolve {stdout, stderr, code} regardless of exit status. A tool that must treat a failing command as a normal answer branches on result.code; one that relies on a throw for failure detection will never see a non-zero exit.

entries.title: launchAuthWeb reports launched before listen actually succeeds
entries.summary: launchAuthWeb returns {kind: launched} synchronously while openUrl fires only from the listen callback; on listen error openUrl never fires, so promise-wrapping callers must bound the wait.

entries.title: bd list --parent excludes closed issues by default; use the documented --all flag to include them
entries.summary: bd list --parent <id> drops closed children unless called with --all. Any child-counting or floor-seeding logic over bd list --parent must pass --all explicitly or it undercounts / resets to zero once all children close.

entries.title: killPidTree bounded wait is only non-hanging because isPidAlive treats a zombie as not-alive
entries.summary: waitForPidGone blocks the main thread with Atomics.wait, so libuv cannot reap a killed direct child; it returns promptly only because isPidAlive reports ps stat Z as dead. The two behaviours are load-bearing on each other.

entries.title: createChildBeadWithAllocatedId has four distinct post-probe failure outcomes and never releases after a landed create
entries.summary: The create, confirm and parent-link steps have separate failure paths: only a pre-create fault releases the allocator reservation, and confirm and link faults each throw their own orphan-naming error.

entries.title: Supervisor ledger setScopeFreshness before start() overwrites the on-disk ledger
entries.summary: createLedger's transact() persists the current in-memory document; before ledger.start() has loaded the file that document is empty, so any setScopeFreshness call before supervisor.start() would write an empty reservations map over the real ledger.

entries.title: A fleet-sprint sandbox copy under os.tmpdir needs a node_modules symlink, and rmSync will not follow it
entries.summary: Copying fleet-sprint/ outside the repo breaks bare-specifier resolution for @apralabs workspace packages, so the sandbox must symlink the hoisted node_modules back in; fs.rmSync recursive cleanup unlinks that symlink without recursing into the real directory.

entries.title: sprintMutexId pins the member-reservation key, not the engine run-state runId
entries.summary: cli.mjs reserves members with sprintId: branchName always, while effectiveRunId (run-id or branchName) keys only run-state files -- the two diverge under a supervisor launch.

entries.title: Viewer summary core fields refresh via broadcast(), so a new lifecycle handler must broadcast or call refreshSummary
entries.summary: state.summary core fields in createDashboardViewer are only kept current because refreshSummary() runs inside broadcast() plus the SIGINT/SIGTERM paths; a handler that mutates state without broadcasting leaves GET /state?summary=1 stale.

entries.title: The child-id collision probe reads bd's error payload out of CommandError.details.text, and depends on structuredContent.exitCode
entries.summary: classifyBdShowProbeError can only tell a free id from a probe fault because FleetWorkflow.command() throws a CommandError carrying the raw output on details.text when the server reports a non-zero structuredContent.exitCode; on a server without exitCode no throw happens and every explicit-id child create fails closed.

entries.title: memberIdentifier leaves both member_id and member_name optional, so zod alone cannot enforce 'a member is required'
entries.summary: src/utils/resolve-member.ts's shared memberIdentifier spread declares member_id and member_name as z.string().optional(), so every tool schema that spreads it accepts a body naming no member; the handler then returns a prose error string rather than failing validation.

entries.title: regression-test-playbook.md's Setup/Reset/Teardown headings appear as backticked prose mentions elsewhere in the file, so naive string.split('## Setup') is unsafe
entries.summary: Any script or test that wants to isolate the Setup/Reset/Teardown sections of regression-test-playbook.md by splitting on the heading text must anchor to a whole line (e.g. /^## Setup$/m), not do a plain substring split -- the file's own intro and cross-reference prose repeatedly mentions `## Setup`, `## Reset`, `## Teardown` inside backticks well before the real headings, and a plain .split('## Setup')[1] picks up that prose fragment instead of the actual section body.

entries.title: The usage-limit re-probe lives in its own module to keep runner.js dispatch-free
entries.summary: usage-limit-controller.mjs hosts the usage-limit wake re-probe (a real but deliberately unbracketed agent() dispatch) outside runner.js because runner.js's agent() census is pinned at zero now that every role ladder runs through dispatchRole.

entries.title: parseVcsCurlOutput must take the status from the LAST line only
entries.summary: Taking the curl -w status trailer as the LAST line, rather than by any digit-matching search, keeps a response body's own digits-only lines from being mistaken for the HTTP status.

entries.title: retry.authSelfHealShortCircuits is inert at final-review's shipped attempts=2 and can only be observed by splicing attempts=3
entries.summary: The healed retry consumes attempt one, so at a two-attempt budget the short-circuit and the generic retry coincide; a mutation test must raise attempts on BOTH arms and vary only the flag, otherwise the field reads identically either way and looks unfalsifiable.

entries.title: A new role-policies budget name must be registered in the test harness in lockstep or the whole se suite throws
entries.summary: resolveBudget throws on an unregistered budget name, so renaming a budget in role-policies.mjs without updating the test fixtures turns a two-file change into ~130 failures across seven files.

entries.title: member-provisioning.mjs is barred from any includes/match/toLowerCase call
entries.summary: phase5-consumer-migration-end-state.test.mjs fails if member-provisioning.mjs contains any .includes( / .match( / .toLowerCase() call, even Array membership checks. Use Set, regex .test() or status checks instead.

entries.title: Migrating a per-file callTool mock onto the shared vcs_credential_exec simulator silently replaces that file's own token literal
entries.summary: The shared mock vcs_credential_exec simulator substitutes two hard-coded tokens, so a migrated test that asserts on its own distinct token either goes red or, worse, keeps a no-leak assertion that can no longer fail.

entries.title: doltPullBefore records the remote tip before the caller re-lists, so a failed post-pull list is not retried
entries.summary: doltPullBefore records the new remote tip as soon as the pull succeeds. A caller that skips its re-list on remote-unchanged must also track whether its own last list succeeded; otherwise a list failure after a successful pull leaves stale data marked fresh.

entries.title: gitnexus readiness fences a live analyze before meta completeness
entries.summary: codeIndexReadiness reports 'building' whenever an analyze is live (lock, isReindexRunning, or recorded run alive), even if meta.json looks complete, because analyze rewrites the index in place; callGitNexus also discards answers if the index generation changed during the call.

entries.title: code-intelligence telemetry USAGE_DIR ignores FLEET_DIR and APRA_FLEET_DATA_DIR
entries.summary: USAGE_DIR is hard-wired to homedir()/.apra-fleet/data/code-intelligence, so test data-dir isolation via APRA_FLEET_DATA_DIR does not cover usage.jsonl.

entries.title: The unref-ed exit-drain timer is never the last live handle -- the handle that outlives the window differs per path
entries.summary: strategy.ts and ssh.ts unref the exit-drain timer; it is safe because child stdio pipes (local) or the ssh2 TCP socket (ssh) stay ref-ed while draining matters. Every dispatch timer in these paths is unref-ed by convention.

entries.title: The ctx.steps hook bodies are the one part of a migrated ladder no dispatch-pin test executes
entries.summary: dispatch-role-harness.mjs supplies recording stubs for ctx.steps, so runner.js's own step implementations are proved to be INVOKED but never proved to be CORRECT by the pin tests.

entries.title: Testing the exit-drain path needs a pipe-holder, not just a forced predicate -- otherwise the test is vacuous
entries.summary: The close handler and the exit-drain timer race to finalize(); a test only exercises the drain path if something withholds pipe EOF, e.g. a detached grandchild inheriting fd 1/2.

entries.title: Only scripts/run-tests.mjs makes scaledTimeout() non-inert in the apra-fleet-se suite
entries.summary: scaledTimeout() scales only when APRA_FLEET_TEST_CONCURRENCY is set, and scripts/run-tests.mjs is the single writer -- any raw node --test invocation silently runs every scaled budget unscaled.

entries.title: Source-text scanners that mask comments/strings must also recognise regex literals, via the shared canStartRegex/skipRegexLiteral
entries.summary: fleet-sprint guard scanners walk source over a comment-masked copy; a regex literal whose body contains a quote is misread as opening a string and desyncs the walk. The shared canStartRegex()/skipRegexLiteral() in dispatch-safety-guard.mjs must run before the string branch.

entries.title: dolt-orphan-sweep owner scoping is opt-in via FLEET_SE_SWEEP_OWNER_DATA_DIR, and must stay opt-in
entries.summary: buildSweepCommand() accepts an owner data-dir prefix that both shell families enforce, wired by bin/serve.mjs from FLEET_SE_SWEEP_OWNER_DATA_DIR; it cannot be derived from FLEET_SE_DATA_DIR because the ephemeral --data-dir belongs to the member, not the supervisor.

entries.title: Supervisor summary pulls must be started before any per-row await in buildSprintViews
entries.summary: dashboard.mjs buildSprintViews only stays within one summary timeout because every row's pullSprintSummary promise is created up front, before the bulk bd fetch and per-row awaits; moving the pull inside the per-row body makes N hung children cost up to N timeouts.
